# Relocations from single statements, as whole objects against llvm-mc and
# as relocations against GNU as. Symbols carry the leading underscore i386
# Windows code uses: it is part of the name as the source writes it.
call _foo
call _foo+4
jmp _foo
je _foo-8
movl _foo, %eax
movl _foo+4, %eax
movl $_foo, %eax
movl %eax, _foo(,%ecx,4)
leal _foo+12, %edx
pushl $_foo
.long _foo
.long _foo+8
.rva _foo
.rva _foo+3
.secrel32 _foo
.secrel32 _foo+1
.secidx _foo
.long _foo@IMGREL
.long _foo - .
.data; .long _foo - .
.text; .globl _foo; _foo: ret; call _foo
.text; _foo: ret; .long _foo
.data; _foo: .long 0; .long _foo+4
.text; call _bar; .data; _bar: .long 1
.data; .rva _bar; .text; _bar: ret
.data; .long _bar - .; .text; _bar: ret
